verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any form of tracking device. Health authorities and fact-checkers have repeatedly confirmed that the publicly available vaccine ingredients do not include any electronic components.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of evidence from multiple TIER_1 sources, including government health agencies like the CDC and the Indonesian Ministry of Health, as well as numerous fact-checking organizations, confirms that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. The ingredients are publicly known and do not include any electronic components. The claim is a widely debunked conspiracy theory, and related claims about magnetic effects have also been proven false.
